verdict.rationale: Ultrametric explicitly states it runs no model and relies on the user's own external agent (Codex, Claude Code, or an MCP host), so delegation happens through an outside AI rather than a built-in assistant. Serving process guides and context to external agents over the CLI or MCP is an adjacent capability, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
